**Carl Moebis** · Slovakia · [moebis.com](https://moebis.com)

Building with AI, Tech, 3D Printers, Drones, and whatever else refuses to behave. I test things, make things, and share the useful bits.

- [asus-fusion-vpn](https://github.com/moebis/asus-fusion-vpn): Native macOS menu bar app for ASUSWRT VPN Fusion over LAN-only SSH.
- [cloud.point.cloud](https://github.com/moebis/cloud.point.cloud): Native Apple Silicon 3D point-cloud reconstruction from video or live camera, powered by MLX and LingBot-Map.
- [Whisper](https://github.com/moebis/Whisper): macOS menu bar dictation app powered by OpenAI realtime transcription.
